bio.text: Mike Levin has represented California's 49th Congressional District, which includes North County San Diego and South Orange County, since January 2019.

He was born in Inglewood, California, in 1978, and earned a bachelor's degree in political science from Stanford University (2001), where he was student body president, and a J.D. from Duke University School of Law (2005).
Before Congress he worked as an environmental attorney and served as executive director of the Democratic Party of Orange County.
He is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.
